_note: Rules and timing said plainly after the seventh (cold) playtest (docs/design/playtest-7-cold.md, items 3 to 8 and 12). Plain words, reading age 11, no sentence over 18 words.
guide.how4: There are two scores: life now, and what is left for 2050. Your result is whichever does worse.
guide.coins_capped: You cannot play another card this turn. Save these coins: up to 2 carry over.
end.rule_line: Two scores count. Your result is the one that did worse since 2026: {side}.
end.counts_up_less.one: your result: up 1 point since 2026, less than the other
end.counts_up_less.other: your result: up {n} points since 2026, less than the other
endturn.capped_limit.one: Trust lets you play 1 card this turn, and it is played. These coins cannot buy a card.
endturn.capped_limit.other: Trust lets you play {n} cards this turn, and all {n} are played. These coins cannot buy a card.
endturn.capped_price.one: Every card left in your hand costs more than you have. These coins cannot buy a card.
endturn.capped_price.other: Every card left in your hand costs more than you have. These coins cannot buy a card.
endturn.capped_lost.one: The other 1 cannot be kept. That is not your mistake: no card was left to spend it on.
endturn.capped_lost.other: The other {n} cannot be kept. That is not your mistake: no card was left to spend them on.
changed.started_quiet: {card} started work this turn. It has not moved a goal by a whole point yet.
changed.starts_next: {card} starts work next turn. Look for it in What happened, {from} to {to}.
opening.started_line: {card}, played {year}: starts work now, in full from {full}
opening.full_line: {card}, played {year}: now works in full, after starting in {from}
visit.stay_card: If you stay away, {card} still works as normal. You just do not choose how.
visit.stay_cards: If you stay away, {card} still work as normal. You just do not choose how.
visit.stay_none: No card of yours is waiting on this visit. If you stay away, nothing changes here.
crisis.from: This crisis grew out of a slow change: {trend}, under way since {year}.
